summary: Completed frontend-only end-to-end testing of the KFZ-Meisterwerkstatt Isaak static landing page across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All required content, German business data, data-testids, tel:/Google-Maps CTAs, reveal headings, mobile menu, mobile call bar, map iframe, and Impressum verified. No console errors, no page errors.

issues: Two console warnings: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' This is a framer-motion warning — non-blocking but worth fixing by adding `relative` to the scroll target's parent or to the wrapperRef container if not already set.

action_items: (Optional) Silence the framer-motion useScroll position warning in HeroScroll.jsx by ensuring the scroll wrapper has an explicit non-static position class (it already has `relative` but the warning still fires — investigate the underlying ancestor).
critical_code_review_comments: Hero headline uses a soft-hyphen (\u00ad) between 'Meister' and 'werkstatt' which produces 'Meister­werkstatt'. Visually fine, but screen readers/SEO may read it as one word. Acceptable.
Reveal/RevealText word spans render trailing   (non-breaking space) which means programmatic text search must use \u00a0 (mostly a testing nuance, not a bug).
All env vars correctly sourced; no hardcoded URLs; data-testids present on every required element; tel: and maps links match the spec exactly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only static site; all data-testids verified. Verified: hero-scroll-container, hero-headline ('Meisterwerkstatt Isaak'), hero-wheel-image, hero-cta-call=tel:+495272390854, hero-cta-appointment=#kontakt, main-nav + 4 nav-link-* + nav-call-button, scroll-scrub Phase D shows hero-phone-big='05272 390854' tel:+495272390854, services-section + all 5 service cards (reparatur/inspektion/reifenservice/felgenservice/werkstattservice), trust-card-0..3, contact-section with contact-phone/mobile/call-button/route-button, opening-hours-list 7 rows incl. Sonntag Geschlossen, location-section with location-map iframe (maps.google embed) and location-route-button (target=_blank, google maps dir URL), main-footer with Impressum (§5 TMG, Andreas Isaak, address, phone), footer-call tel link, mobile-call-bar visible on mobile and hidden on desktop, mobile-menu-toggle/mobile-menu/mobile-menu-close all functional. 0 page errors, only 2 non-blocking framer-motion position warnings.
